description: Iterative probe: for each (atom, nucleon_ordering, electron_distribution), compute the Hecke character fingerprint (χ_λ for every λ ⊢ 3A) and the Plancherel tr_M.  Character fingerprints are strong NF-equivalence checks: equal fingerprints ⇒ equal H_{3A} elements, different fingerprints ⇒ different atoms.  Witness is saved after each case; resume skips completed ones.
